meta.title: Model workbench
meta.description: Adds a Model workbench entry to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing the official Magpie GUI in the main area. The bundle page includes an install card: manually download and verify the official Magpie binary from GitHub, configure a permanent GitHub mirror, and detect other Magpie plugins inside DSH to avoid duplicates. The engine runs in a DSH-managed private directory with random ports and starts on demand; models can be synced to the DSH picker manually. Uninstalling the engine or the plugin fully removes the engine, data, settings and model providers, leaving no residue.
